description: objekts Production Desk is a production-planning and feasibility service for commercial visual work operated by objekts. Its public integration surface is a remote MCP server for diagnosis, estimates, and optional human handoff, alongside machine-readable discovery endpoints (`/about`, `/health`, `/llms.txt`) documented by an OpenAPI contract.
summary: mcp.objekts.ai exposes a public streamable HTTP MCP server at `/mcp` plus a small unauthenticated HTTP discovery contract/OpenAPI at the site root.
